mapper.select: SELECT p.game_id, p.skill_key, p.process_key, p.name, p.activation_type, p.description, p.sort_order, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT s.step_key) AS integer) AS step_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT b.binding_key) AS integer) AS effect_binding_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.operation_key) AS integer) AS state_operation_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM public.skill_processes p LEFT JOIN public.skill_process_steps s ON s.game_id = p.game_id AND s.skill_key = p.skill_key AND s.process_key = p.process_key LEFT JOIN public.skill_process_effect_bindings b ON b.game_id = p.game_id AND b.skill_key = p.skill_key AND b.process_key = p.process_key LEFT JOIN public.skill_process_state_operations o ON o.game_id = p.game_id AND o.skill_key = p.skill_key AND o.process_key = p.process_key WHERE p.game_id = #{gameId} AND p.skill_key = #{skillKey} GROUP BY p.game_id, p.skill_key, p.process_key, p.name, p.activation_type, p.description, p.sort_order, p.created_at, p.updated_at ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.process_key ASC
